  5. If Cy leads S5, then Ed must lead S1.
  6. Bo leads at most 0 sessions.

  11. If Ed leads S1, then Ana must lead S3.

problem.reference_answer: S1=Ed, S2=Cy, S3=Ana, S4=Ed, S5=Cy, S6=Ana, S7=Cy, S8=Ed
